P1 How can one person enjoy good health, while another person looks old before her time? Humans have been asking this question for thousands of years, and recently, it's becoming clearer and clearer to scientists that the differences between people's rates of aging lie in the complex interactions among genes, social relationships, environments and lifestyles. Even though you were born with a particular set of genes, the way you live can influence how they express themselves. Some lifestyle factors may even turn genes on or shut them off.

P2 Deep within the genetic heart of all our cells are telomeres, or repeating segments of noncoding DNA that live at the ends of the chromosomes(染色体). They form caps at the ends of the chromosomes and keep the genetic material together. Shortening with each cell division, they help determine how fast a cell ages. When they become too short, the cell stops dividing altogether. This isn't the only reason a cell can age—there are other stresses on cells we don't yet understand very well—but short telomeres are Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage. one of the major reasons human cells grow old. We've devoted most of our careers to studying telomeres, and one extraordinary discovery from our labs is that telomeres can actually lengthen.

P3 Scientists have learned that several thought patterns appear to be unhealthy for telomeres, and one of them is cynical hostility. Cynical hostility is defined by high anger and frequent thoughts that other people cannot be trusted. Someone with hostility doesn't just think, "I hate to stand in long lines"; they think, "Others deliberately sped up and beat me to my rightful position in the line!"—and then get violently agitated. People who score high on measures of cynical hostility tend to get more heart disease, metabolic disease and often die at younger ages. They also have shorter telomeres. In a study of British civil servants, men who scored high on measures of cynical hostility had shorter telomeres than men whose hostility scores were low. The most hostile men were 30% more likely to have short telomeres.

P4 What this means: aging is a dynamic process that could possibly be accelerated or slowed—and, in some aspects, even reversed. To an extent, it has surprised us and the rest of the scientific community that telomeres do not simply carry out the commands issued by your genetic code. Your telomeres are listening to you. The foods you eat, your response to challenges, the amount of exercise you get, and many other factors appear to influence your telomeres and can prevent premature aging at the cellular level. One of the keys to enjoying good health is simply doing your part to foster healthy cell renewal. 46. What have scientists come to know better today? A) Why people age at different rates. B) How genes influence the aging process. C) How various genes express themselves in aging. D) Why people have long been concerned about aging.

P1 Scientists have created by accident an enzyme(酶) that breaks down plastic drinks bottles. The breakthrough could help solve the global plastic pollution crisis by enabling for the first time the full recycling of bottles.

P2 The new research was spurred by the discovery in 2016 of the first bacterium that had naturally evolved to eat plastic at a waste dump in Japan. Scientists have now revealed the detailed structure of the crucial enzyme produced by the bug.

P3 An international team then adjusted the enzyme to see how it had evolved, but tests showed they had accidentally made the molecule even better at breaking down the plastic used for drinks bottles. "What actually turned out was we improved the enzyme, which was a bit of a shock," said head researcher Prof. McGeehan, at the University of Portsmouth, UK. Questions 51 to 55 are based on the following passage.

P4 Currently, the enzyme takes a few days to start breaking down the plastic, far faster than the centuries it takes in the oceans, but the researchers are optimistic this can be speeded up even further and become a viable large-scale process.

P5 "What we are hoping to do is use this enzyme to turn this plastic back into its original components, so we can literally recycle it back to plastic," said McGeehan. "It means we won't need to dig up any more oil and, fundamentally, it should reduce the amount of plastic in the environment."

P6 About 1 million plastic bottles are sold each minute around the globe and, with just 14% recycled, many end up in the oceans where they have polluted even the remotest parts, harming marine life and potentially people who eat sea food. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
writing.model: Today increasing importance is being attached to cultivating college students' team spirit. Both universities and future employers have realized that few achievements today are the work of a single hand, so this quality truly deserves our attention. There are convincing reasons behind this trend. First, almost every modern task, from a laboratory experiment to a business start-up, demands that people with different strengths pool their efforts; without cooperation, even talented individuals can accomplish little. Second, working in a team teaches students to communicate patiently, respect different opinions, and share responsibility, all of which are qualities that textbooks alone can never provide. A student who once relied only on personal effort, for instance, may finally learn to trust others after completing a group project together. For these reasons, team spirit should never be treated as something optional. Colleges ought to design more group tasks, and students themselves should step out of their comfort zones and embrace cooperation, because it is teamwork that turns scattered abilities into real strength.

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 以高原为主语的并列陈述（主语策略：原句主语） 中文主语明确就是 云贵高原，全句围绕它陈述四项信息。可把核心立为 The Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau is located in… / is China's fourth largest plateau，主语 The Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau，谓语用 is located / is，宾语/表语是位置和「第四大高原」。其余「面积」「海拔」两 项作补充信息处理。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 数据信息降级为插入/分句 本句一口气堆了四个信息点，不能用 and 平铺成一长串。把 大部分位于云南、贵州省境内 作主干 (is mostly located in…)；总面积约50万平方公里，平均海拔2000-4000米 这两项数据降级，用 with 引导的伴随介词短语 with a total area of about 500,000 square kilometers and an average altitude of 2,000 to 4,000 meters 挂在主干后；是中国第四大高原 作收尾的并列表语， 用分号或 and it is… 收束。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 回指全篇基调，陈述客观地理事实，用一般现在时 is located / is，不要用过去时。 数字表达 50万平方公里写作 500,000 square kilometers（不是 50 万直译 fifty ten-thousand）；海拔区 间 2000-4000 米写作 2,000 to 4,000 meters，用 to 表区间。 单复数与冠词 fourth largest plateau 是序数词最高级，前面必须加 the：China's fourth largest plateau 或 the fourth largest plateau in China。square kilometers、meters 复数。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: Located mostly in Yunnan Province and Guizhou Province, the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau, with a total area of about 500,000 square kilometers and an average altitude of 2,000 to 4,000 meters, is the fourth largest plateau in China. 2. 云贵高原西高东低，河流众多，形成了许多又深又陡的峡谷(canyon)。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 高原作主语贯穿三个分句（主语策略：原句主语） 三个分句 西高东低，河流众多，形成了许多又深又陡的峡谷 共享同一主语'云贵高原'。最核心的动 作是'形成了…峡谷'，故主干立为 The plateau has formed many canyons / many canyons have formed，主语 The plateau，谓语 form，宾语 canyons；'西高东低''河流众多'是造成峡谷 的背景条件。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 地势与成因降级为状语 西高东低 是地势特征，可处理成主句前的状语分句 Higher in the west and lower in the east 或 With its terrain高 in the west…；河流众多 是密集成因，与'形成峡谷'是因果，可降级为 with numerous rivers 的伴随短语，或译成 where numerous rivers… 引出。'又深又陡'作 canyons 的 前置定语 deep and steep。整句重构为：地势状语 + 主干（众多河流形成了又深又陡的峡谷）。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 '形成了'虽带'了'，但描述的是至今仍存在的地貌结果，用一般现在时 forms / has formed 均可， 与全篇现在时基调一致；推荐 has formed 兼顾'已形成且仍在'，但保持一般现在时 form 也对，关 键是不要用一般过去时 formed（会读成过去一次性事件）。 单复数 '许多峡谷'是复数 many canyons；'河流众多'是 numerous rivers，均用复数，呼应'许多/众多'。 形容词并列 '又深又陡'两个形容词并列修饰 canyons，用 deep and steep，置于名词前作定语。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: High in the west and low in the east, the plateau is crisscrossed by numerous rivers, which have carved out many deep and steep canyons. 3. 峡谷中许多地方土壤肥沃，非常有利于多种农作物生长。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 以土壤肥沃为主、利于生长为果（主语策略：原句主语） 中文有明确主语 峡谷中许多地方，核心陈述是'土壤肥沃'。可立主干 The soil is fertile（主语 the soil，系动词 is，表语 fertile），或以 many places 作主语 Many places… have fertile soil。'非 常有利于…生长'是这肥沃带来的结果，作后续。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 有利于生长降级为结果状语 非常有利于多种农作物生长 不另起一句，而降级为表结果的成分：可用 which is very favorable for the growth of various crops 定语从句，或 making it ideal for growing various crops 的现 在分词结果状语挂在主干后。'多种农作物'译 various / a variety of crops。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 陈述土壤的客观属性，回指全篇一般现在时 is fertile / is favorable。 单复数与不可数名词 soil（土壤）作'土壤'整体义时为不可数名词，用 the soil、不加复数；crops（农作物）是可 数，'多种'用复数 various crops。 介词搭配 '有利于'后接对象用 favorable for / beneficial to；'有利于…生长'用 favorable for the growth of… 或 for growing…，介词不要错配成 favorable to growth。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: In many parts of these canyons, the soil is fertile, which is highly favorable for the growth of various crops. 4. 云贵高原独特的自然环境造就了生物和文化的多样性。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 环境作主语造就多样性（主语策略：原句主语） 中文是标准的'施事 + 动作 + 宾语'结构：主语 云贵高原独特的自然环境，谓语'造就了'，宾语'生物 和文化的多样性'。直接对译主干 The unique natural environment has created/given rise to biological and cultural diversity，主谓宾一一对应。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 本句结构简单无需大改 本句是单一主谓宾的简单句，无多余分句要降级。唯一处理是把'独特的'作前置定语 unique 修饰 natural environment，'生物和文化的'作并列定语 biological and cultural 修饰 diversity。结构 上照搬即可，重点在选准'造就了'的英文动词。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 '造就了'描述至今仍存在的多样性，用现在完成时 has created / has given rise to 或一般现在时 creates 皆可，与全篇基调统一，不用一般过去时。 单复数与不可数名词 diversity（多样性）为不可数名词，不加 s；environment 特指这片高原的环境，用 the unique natural environment 加 the。 并列定语 '生物和文化的多样性'即'生物多样性和文化多样性'，用 biological and cultural diversity，两个形 容词并列共享 diversity。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: The unique natural environment of the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau has given rise to rich biological and cultural diversity. 5. 它是中国森林和矿产资源类型十分丰富的地区，也是古人类起源的重要地区。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 代词它作主语的双重定性（主语策略：原句主语） 主语是承接上句的代词 它（指云贵高原），用 It 即可。本句是'它是 A，也是 B'的双重定性：主干 It is a region…（系动词 is + 表语 region），两个'地区'用并列结构 It is… and also…连接。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 两重身份用并列表语处理 中国森林和矿产资源类型十分丰富的地区 中'森林和矿产资源类型十分丰富'是 region 的修饰，用 with rich types of forest and mineral resources 介词短语，或 rich in forest and mineral resources 后置；古人类起源的重要地区 用 an important area for the origin of ancient humans。两个'地区'用 It is… and also… 并列，避免重复主语。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 客观定性，回指全篇一般现在时 It is…。 单复数 '资源类型'用 types of… resources，types 复数；forest and mineral resources 中 resources 复 数；'地区'两处可用 a region / an area，单数加冠词。 冠词 两个'地区'是泛指其中一类，用不定冠词 a region / an important area；an 用在元音音素 important 前。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: It is a region rich in various types of forest and mineral resources in China, and it is also an important area for the origin of ancient humans. 6. 云贵高原是中国少数民族数量最多的地区，各民族都保留了自己丰富多彩的文化传统。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 两个分句各有主语（主语策略：原句主语） 本句含两个主语不同的分句：前句 云贵高原是中国少数民族数量最多的地区，主语云贵高原（可用 It 承接），主干 It is the region with the largest number of ethnic minorities；后句 各民族都 保留了自己丰富多彩的文化传统，主语换成'各民族'，主干 each ethnic group preserves its cultural traditions。两分句不共主语，需各立主谓。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 后句用where从句衔接前句 前句 数量最多的地区 用最高级 the largest number of…；后句 各民族都保留了自己丰富多彩的文 化传统 与前句是'在这个地区里，各民族…'的关系，最自然是用 where 引导定语从句把后句挂到 region 上：…the largest number of ethnic minorities, where each group preserves its colorful cultural traditions。'丰富多彩的'作定语 colorful / rich and colorful。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 '保留了'的'了'同样指至今仍保留的状态，用一般现在时 preserves / retain 或现在完成时 have preserved，与全篇基调统一，不用一般过去时。 最高级与冠词 '数量最多'用最高级 the largest number of，前面必须加 the。 主谓一致与单复数 ethnic minorities / ethnic groups 复数；若用 each ethnic group 作主语，each 后接单数名 词、谓语用单数 preserves its…；若用 various ethnic groups 则谓语用复数 preserve their…， 主谓与代词须一致。
